column2: Figures. Cops in lawless Kanto ain't gonna be just ordinary cops.
Those bastards wield police power however they please! They pretend to uphold the law while they run this town!
What scumbags!
Hiding behind a badge makes 'em worse than cockroaches!
And on top of that, they're strong!
Anyway, we can't just leave things like this!
I hear the groans of those the Reaper Police have killed... The wind whispers to me: kill them, every last one...
Jack...
Been a while since my blood got pumping like this...
I won't forgive the Reaper Police!
All right, let's go!
Wh-who's there?
We came to rescue you. You're safe now!
Ayuko!
Papaaa!
I don't know how I can ever thank you all...
Oh, right, there's no time for this!\n\nWe're in trouble! The Dragons are back! And this time the Slum King himself is leading them!
What!?
Ayuko-chan, you two stay here. It's up to us to handle this!
Jack versus the Slum King...\n\nThis fight might decide who rules Kanto...
Jack...!?
GRAAAAAAAH!
Now it's the Slum King...? And I thought we were finally safe...
We're in trouble! The Dragons are back! And this time the Slum King himself is leading them!
We came to rescue you. You're safe now. Let's get out of here together!
Are you Ayuko-chan?
Wh-who's there!? Did you come to save me? ...But this door won't open without the key. The chief of the Reaper Police HQ has it.
This door won't open without the key.\n\nThe chief of the Reaper Police HQ has it.
Who goes there... Suspicious punks! I'll throw you all in the slammer!!
I've heard there's a jail under the Reaper Police HQ... Ayuko must be down there...
We meet at last, Honey Kisaragi. ...Or should I say, the android Cutie Honey?
Who's there!?
Sister Jill, head of Panther Claw's Japan branch. To you, I suppose, your father's killer. After all, I'm the one who ordered the attack on the Kisaragi mansion...
So... it was you...
If he had just handed over the Airborne Element Fixer like a good boy, he wouldn't have had to die... The fool.
Honey! Calm down!
Still, that Dr. Kisaragi was quite something. While we were chasing you, it seems we wandered into this post-quake world. Just what sort of technology did he use?
Hey, hey, Mondo.\n\nCould it be this lady's got nothing to do with the Slum King?
The Slum King? What are you talking about?
...Looks that way.
Then she's just like us...
Bah! What nonsense are you babbling!? We searched for the Fixer, but we couldn't find it anywhere! But when we learned you existed, it dawned on us!
*Gulp!*
Dr. Kisaragi must have hidden the device in the safest vault of all... the vault that is his daughter's body...\n\nA pity, but I'll be examining your body! By dissecting it!
Whoa, that's one scary dame!
Sister Jill, my father's killer!\n\nThe pain you've put in my heart, I'll make you feel it with this sword!
You'll regret this!
GRAAAAAAAH!
Zanbato!
Wh-whoa, amaaazing...
Jack versus the King, huh! Now that's a matchup... Heh, one hell of a matchup!
Slum King-sama is in trouble! To his aid!
We'll help Jack too!
Gyaaah!\n\nAaargh! Whoaaa!!
H-his spare mask... Quickly!\n\nThe King wears his sturdy armor to hold back his overpowered muscles! Hurry, the mask! His head will split open!!
Hahaha!
...!? A-another earthquake!?
Eeeeeek!!
E-earthquaaake!!
It's shaking like crazy!
Mondo! Do something!
Don't be stupid!
Could this be... the Kanto Hellquake all over again...?
Thank goodness! You're all okay!
Ayuko-chan!
I truly don't know how to thank you for all this...
You folks are our saviors!
Welp... Guess it's time...
Yes, we'd better be going.
By the way, where are you guys headed?
Actually...
...I'll go with you.
Jack?
With you along, we've got the strength of a hundred! Jack can babysit {p}, and I'll have Honey all to myself... Heh heh heh heh...
Then we'll come too.
If Mondo's going, so am I!
Aw, man... There goes my big plan...
What's got you so down in the dumps?
Nothing at all... *sigh*...
All right, let's go!
Huh? A road to the mountains...? Hmm, beats me. I only know of the one...
Don't worry, {p}. I'm sure {s} is fine. We made it out of a pretty tight spot ourselves, after all!
What's the matter? You look down. If you're hungry, I'll feed you till you're stuffed, anytime!
Thanks, mister.
Even with the Reaper Police gone, I bet the next bunch of outlaws will turn up.
That quake just now took years off my life.
I want to see my family too...\n\nBut there's no way I can swim across the Great Kanto Fault...
So you're the ones who rescued Ayuko-chan!? Well, that's really something!\n\nI hear the checkpoint west of the Reaper Police has been opened too. Maybe that means we can have a little hope.
I hope I get to see you all again...
Sure, anytime's OK by me.
Oh, Mondo, honestly!
Thank you for everything you did for us.\n\nI only hope we can live in peace from now on...
Mondo-san... *blush*
Now this is a lucky find!
Do you think it still runs?
I think it'll be fine.
All right! It's running!
Kyaaa! Seiji-kun, you're amaaazing!
Aw, shucks... Heh heh...
